string: Devices find each other over an encrypted channel that runs on a Curve key pair. The pair is generated off this phone — your dashboard shows both keys as text — and pasting the two 40-character keys here is the entire setup. Without a pair the discovery node refuses to run; it never falls back to unencrypted.
Key pair complete — the discovery node rebuilds with it now.
Paste both 40-character keys exactly as the dashboard shows them.
